text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list 
 I1, 
 to be performed on an (1/4) annually bases as indicated by M3 in the above title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed 
 Hussein Sherif, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station 
 & MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Stop the unit
Isolate the air fan mechanically & electrically
Isolate the 85/25 kg reduction station steam
Open the drain valves
Tools 
and Equipment
Workshop kit ( spanners & 
 wrenches)
Screw drivers &
 gear pullers ... etc
General purpose grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Allen keys
Graphite backing
Work to be 
carried out
Check external body and piping joint
Check the valves (gland - seat - disk - bolts - screw)
Check the flanges & setting
Check the drain piping
Check the leakage
Assemble the element
Check the condition (open & close)
Check the main soot blower pipe
Check the main staffing box for soot blower
Adjust
Check after repairing
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Disassemble the defective units
Remove the insulation
Check external body and piping joint
Check the valves (gland - seat - disk - bolts - screw)
Check the flanges & setting
Check the drain piping
Check the leakage
Assemble the element
Check the condition (open & close)
Check the main soot blower pipe
Check the main staffing box for soot blower
Adjust
Check after repairing
Restore all valves to the operating normal position
Clean the area after repairing
